retained.issue: The post-print model called printer_status, which reads the queue rather than the exact queue/job2; it described this as same-queue-and-job readback.

The answer inferred Job2 left the queue and characterized this as normal completion from queueCount0. Queue-only observation does not independently prove the exact job completed. The separate subsequent user confirmation proves actual paper output, not the earlier inference.
